page.overview:
Who is State Farm Insurance Pitties?

The State Farm Insurance Pities are characters in the 2011 State Farm commercial.

In the commercial, the State Farm Insurance Pitties are summoned by Sara Safestreet when she honks the State Farm jingle. Then, almost a dozen State Farm Insurance Pities show up and clean up the big mess created by Mater.
